Name: Bloodhound Avatar
Information:
**Bloodhound Avatar**

The Bloodhound Avatar is a powerful mortal soul who pledged themselves to Scorn during their life, bleeding the innocent and spreading Scorn’s fury among mortal-kind. Either during life or after death, Scorn may elevate such a soul to a Bloodhound Avatar, which serves as an engine of massacre it deploys in the world. In many cases where a creature ascends to this state while still alive, their mind is broken and they go on a wild killing spree, but those who become Bloodhound Avatars after death retain their senses, though they still inherit a desire to kill anything within reach.

***Weapons of the Beast.*** A Bloodhound Avatar can generally regenerate from any wound dealt to it, but damage from the divine or silver weapons can deal a killing blow that keeps it down.

traits.name: Blood Critical
traits.description: The avatar scores a critical hit on a d20 result of 19 or 20. If its target has fewer than half of their hit points remaining, it scores a critical hit on a d20 result of 18, 19, or 20 instead.

traits.name: Hunting Leap
traits.description: If the avatar moves at least 20 feet in a straight line, it can leap up to 20 feet into the air to avoid obstacles that might impede its path. When it lands, if adjacent to a creature it attacks without moving again, and can make an Exhaust Claw attack against them as a bonus action. On a hit they take no damage, but are knocked prone.

traits.name: Regenerating
traits.description: The avatar only dies if it starts its turn without regenerating hit points through its Regen trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The avatar makes two Exhaust Claw attacks, then uses its Dread Hurl.

actions.name: Exhaust Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dread Hurl
actions.description: The avatar seizes one Huge or smaller creature within reach of its Exhaust Claw, who must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failure, it throws them into an unoccupied space within 40 feet, or at a creature within that range. The second creature in the targeted space must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or be struck by the thrown creature. Targets who fail either save take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone.

actions.name: Bleeding Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The avatar howls, shaking the earth and air within 30 feet of it. Each other creature within that range must make a DC 18 Intelligence saving throw, taking 52 (8d12) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

options.name: Escape
options.description: The avatar moves up to half its movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

options.name: Whirlwind (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: The avatar makes a single Exhaust Claw attack, which is applied to each target it chooses within reach. It then rolls damage once, and applies that damage to each target it has hit.
